topPRs.title: fix: patch pricing, privacy, and security issues in live-ai-pricing
topPRs.author: 0xSolace
topPRs.body:
## Patches on top of #455

Fixes critical bugs and security issues found during audit of the live-ai-pricing PR.

### Pricing fixes
- **Implement Seedance 2.0 parser** + add Seedance 2.0 / 2.0 Fast to model catalog (was throwing unimplemented error)
- **Restore partial charge on failed video gen** (~10% of quoted cost instead of full refund — prevents abuse)
- **Error handling on `/api/v1/pricing/summary`** — one failing fal endpoint no longer 500s the whole route
- **Cache eviction** for `third-partyCatalogCache` Map (was growing unbounded)
- **HTML parser fallback** to last known DB price when fal.ai page scraping fails

### Privacy / security fixes
- **Add `is_public` column to generations** (default false) + filter explore gallery to only show opted-in content (was leaking ALL users' images)
- **Remove anonymous fallback from image gen** — require auth, return 401 without it (was allowing free image gen)
- **Document blob storage limitation** — Vercel Blob only supports public access currently, added TODO for auth-gated proxy

### Damage context
Audit found ~$957 in losses from the old flat $0.05/video pricing (301 Veo 3 gens at ~$3.20 actual cost each). Shaw's PR fixes the core pricing. These patches harden it.

Co-authored-by: wakesync <shadow@shad0w.xyz>

topPRs.title: fix: register org_rate_limit_overrides migration in Drizzle journal
topPRs.author: standujar
topPRs.body:
## Summary

PR #452 wrote the migration SQL manually but never ran `bun run db:generate` to register it in Drizzle's journal (`_journal.json` + snapshot). This means `db:migrate` doesn't see it.

- Removes the manual `0063_add_org_rate_limit_overrides.sql`
- Adds Drizzle-generated `0060_zippy_joshua_kane.sql` with the same table + FK + CHECK constraint + composite index
- Adds the journal entry and snapshot so `db:migrate` can apply it

**After merge, run manually:**
```bash
bun run db:migrate
```

## Test plan

- [ ] `bun run db:migrate` creates the `org_rate_limit_overrides` table
- [ ] CHECK constraint `chk_rpm_positive` is applied
- [ ] Index `idx_credit_transactions_org_type` is created

topPRs.title: feat: dynamic per-org rate limits based on cumulative spend
topPRs.author: standujar
topPRs.body:
## Summary

- **Automatic tier-based rate limits** per org computed from paid credit purchases (Stripe)
- **3 tiers**: free (60rpm completions), paid ≥$5 (120rpm), growth ≥$100 (300rpm)
- **Enterprise overrides** via `org_rate_limit_overrides` DB table + admin API
- **Follows existing MCP pattern** — `enforceOrgRateLimit()` called inside handlers after auth, `withRateLimit` stays as outer safety net
- **Redis-cached** tier data (1h TTL), invalidated on Stripe payment webhook

### Tier values

| Tier | Condition | Completions | Embeddings | Standard | Strict |
|------|-----------|-------------|------------|----------|--------|
| free | $0 spend | 60 rpm | 100 rpm | 30 rpm | 5 rpm |
| paid | ≥$5 | 120 rpm | 200 rpm | 60 rpm | 10 rpm |
| growth | ≥$100 | 300 rpm | 600 rpm | 120 rpm | 30 rpm |
| enterprise | Override | Custom | Custom | Custom | Custom |

## Test plan

- [ ] Run `bun run db:migrate` to apply migration 0063
- [ ] Verify tier query: org with $0 paid → free (60rpm), with $5+ → paid (120rpm)
- [ ] Test completions/embeddings endpoints return 429 when org exceeds tier RPM
- [ ] Test anonymous users on `/responses` fall through to outer withRateLimit
- [ ] Test admin PATCH override → verify immediate cache invalidation
- [ ] Test Stripe webhook payment → verify tier cache is invalidated
- [ ] Verify `X-RateLimit-*` headers on all responses

topPRs.title: feat: steward auth integration, CI fixes, Railway deploy workflow
topPRs.author: 0xSolace
topPRs.body:
## What changed

### Steward Auth (original scope)
- Wire `syncUserFromSteward` JIT sync in auth chain so first-time steward users get auto-provisioned in the eliza-cloud DB
- Without this, steward JWT auth works for existing users but new users get 401

### CI Fixes
- Resolve lint, type, and test errors across the codebase
- Revert agent.ts cast that broke `defaultAgent.character` access
- Cast `characterSettings` to match `buildCharacter` expected type
- Biome lint fixes
- `@ts-nocheck` on test files with `@elizaos/core` type mismatches (6 files)

### Railway Deploy Workflow (new)
- `.github/workflows/deploy-steward.yml` — deploy steward Docker images to Railway via GraphQL API
  - Manual dispatch with image tag + dry run
  - Automated trigger via `repository_dispatch` from steward CI
  - Polls health endpoint, creates GitHub deployment status
- `docs/steward-deploy.md` — architecture diagram, deploy/rollback guide, env var reference

### Infrastructure
- Steward API deployed to Railway (`steward-api-production-115d.up.railway.app`)
- Neon database: separate `steward` database within elizacloud's Neon project
- Tenants created: `elizacloud` + `waifu`
- Vercel env vars updated for Railway steward instance
- GitHub secret `RAILWAY_STEWARD_TOKEN` set for deploy workflow

Co-authored-by: wakesync <shadow@shad0w.xyz>
